property_summary: For every admissible Collect(_am) execution, the caller's stored Acc balance must equal the net Ether the caller has paid in minus any Ether successfully sent back to the caller during collection; the mutated version deducts the balance before attempting the external send, so a failed send leaves Acc[caller].balance irreversibly lower than the net contribution, breaking this invariant.
change_summary: Move the balance deduction and log message to before the external value call, causing state to change before the recipient is invoked.
